top.en: TheShy, I actually teared up. Back then, surrounded by Western teams, I thought we were going to be wiped out. The MSI champion and #1 seed got destroyed by G2, and I thought IG wouldn't stand a chance either. Those were the years when Europe was at its peak, but your Jayce and Aatrox tore G2 to shreds. Later, as you got older and were on WBG, you were caught by T1 and have been getting flamed ever since. Yet, there’s never been any off-field drama; you’ve always been hardworking and dedicated. When IG needed you, you came back for a split, and even though you're just a [~0:remnant of the Great Sage] compared to your prime, you still made it to Worlds and pulled off a miracle in the regional qualifiers. The draw was brutal—first GEN, then HLE—but you showed up. Your Kled was just like your Aatrox in the river back in the day; when your teammates said 'let's go,' you engaged. Wei followed you in, leading the brothers. Many times when teammates hesitated, you’d pop your ult and charge. If you int, you int; if you die, you die. Either you take my nexus, or yours explodes. That’s your style, the most charming part of it. When you returned for the third split, your video views were ten times higher than other teams. That’s your charisma, and it’s well-deserved. Yesterday against the Vietnamese team, you were styling on them. This game, you were getting camped, but in teamfights, you gave up everything to help your brothers, letting the bot lane farm and the jungler take the camps. You were down in gold, but the sacrifice was worth it. We won. TheShy, I was a high schooler when you won the title; now I’ve been out of college for two years. Being able to watch your games is my honor. You are my youth. TheShy, every game is one less to watch.

notes.literal: the remnant body of the Great Sage
notes.context: A reference to the final boss in the game Black Myth: Wukong, used here to describe a legendary player who is past their prime but still powerful.

top.en: Hello everyone, I'm TreasonDam. In the Swiss stage that just ended, IG actually speedran HLE to reach the 2-1 bracket. Our 'greatest ADC of all time' faced jiaqi, who spent five years as a sub for [~0:Niao-ge] and is playing his first Worlds, and not only did he burn four summoner spells and get solo killed in under a minute, he also finished 0-6. He was the first to die in teamfights not once, not twice, but three times. He died instantly without dealing any damage, and after leeching gold from Zeus, he still needed Zeus to flank just to win a mid-game fight. He can't even use his ult to save his support anymore. I thought that after Guyusi shamelessly spouted nonsense about 'four championships' and 'the era of Guyusi,' he might actually try, or at least be competent enough to die less. I didn't expect that a person with even a shred of shame, after talking trash, wouldn't at least put on an act. It turns out Guyusi has fully exposed himself as a career academy-level player, a show-off passenger who spends his life being carried, a leech that sucks blood and is still useless. This is a lesson: once someone gains fame and fortune far beyond their ability through connections and being carried, they never bother to improve. Guyusi is the perfect example. After his academy days and amateur tournaments, with zero offers, he used connections to get into SKT to guard the water cooler. He's been academy-level ever since, never even reaching third-team level. Tell me, Guyusi, do you actually believe the garbage you spew? Do you really think you're the greatest ADC of all time? Do you really think you have the level of an LCK starter? Do you really think you could get into SKT's second or third team on your own? Wake up. Leave Zeus and Zeka alone. You're just dead weight who has spent your life clinging to Zeus, Keria and Uncle Faker. It's like someone buying a box of gold bars: Guyusi is just the box, but he got weighed with the gold and priced like it. His fans don't actually think he's gold too, do they? Does Guyusi really think he's on the same level as those players? Great greatest ADC of all time, the bedrock of T1, the founder of the island-ADC who debuted as a hypercarry, please do us a favor and go to the regions that welcome you and hype you up, like the LPL. Just stop ruining the LCK, okay?!

notes.context: Nickname for the senior ADC Jiaqi backed up for years.

top.en: I'm not trying to excuse Kanavi's inting, but his mistake this game wasn't getting blown up in teamfights; it was losing his mind ganking TheShy. HLE's lineup is strong in teamfights but weak on the flanks. They had to catch IG's front line when they couldn't instantly kill Qiyana, then fight and snowball. The ideal state is Olaf and Lissandra harassing from the sides, Kanavi using the grass element to kite up front, Renata's basic abilities protecting anyone who gets touched, Zeus's Lissandra engaging when there's a chance, or Renata's ult counter-engaging when there isn't. The late game relies on Kalista and Olaf to clean up. It was a perfect setup; even if [~0:Egg] got blown up, it wouldn't matter much, it would just make the late game harder and rely more on Zeus. HLE has always played like this. But the problem is this guy is addicted to being a [~1:Peashooter]. He loses his head when he sees TheShy. Brother, what does it matter if you gank Kled to 0-8 or even 0-20? He has his passive and Nocturne; can you really out-position them? Can you really kill him while his passive is up? Ganking TheShy let the Annie, who had a mediocre lane and was very easy to catch, play more and more comfortably. Brother, you rely on the grass element to kite up front; didn't you notice Annie getting fat enough to ignore it and just ult Qiyana dead? And if you'd ganked Annie a few times, what would IG have had left after Zeus traded 1-for-1 with Jiaqi? I just don't understand. He spent the whole game ganking TheShy, who was only there to tank the front line. It's so stupid, really. This guy has no brain once he tilts.

notes.context: Fan nickname for HLE's ADC Gumayusi.
The plant that shoots zombies in Plants vs. Zombies; 'zombie' is a Hupu nickname for TheShy and his fans.
